description: Figure 6 presents a pie chart titled “Token Routing Distribution (FedHLM)” that breaks down token resolution outcomes into three categories, showing how tokens are distributed across resolution routes. The chart contains three slices: “LOCAL” in green occupying the vast majority at approximately 94.5%, “LLM” in red at about 3.93%, and “EDGE_P2P Exchange” in blue at about 1.57%. Percentage values are printed inside the slices, and the category names are placed near the corresponding segments; there is no separate legend visible. None of the slices appear exploded or otherwise visually emphasized, and the slices appear arranged with the largest (LOCAL) dominating the circle and the two smaller slices grouped together near the top-left region.
